theme: Toronto, on the eve of ICGN.
greeting: You're in Toronto for ICGN, Dan — tonight's board dinner, then your panel tomorrow. Today itself stays open, and it's Mike's birthday.

needsAttention.title: ICGN panel in the morning

acts.line: A quiet morning in Toronto, and it's Mike's birthday before the governance crowd gathers.
The afternoon stays open; your panel materials are printed and waiting at the UPS store.
The ICGN board dinner at Lee Restaurant closes the day, the night before you take the stage.
